title: About Online Plants Cart | Plant Nursery and Green Services, Delhi NCR
description: Online Plants Cart supplies plants in bulk and looks after the spaces they go into, working with offices, societies, builders and homeowners across Delhi NCR.
h1: We would rather sell you fewer plants that live
lede: Online Plants Cart grew out of nursery supply and moved into services for a simple reason. We kept delivering healthy plants to places that had no plan for keeping them healthy.
cta_text: You are welcome at the nursery. Call ahead so someone is free to walk you through it properly.
